visualCharacteristics.summary: Split garage intro: h1, lead, brand lists, favourite/team links, 6-image slider + appointment CTA
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Garage detail page intro — text column (adopted breadcrumb, h1, lead, VERKAUF/SERVICE brand-logo lists, icon text links) beside a 4:3 image slider that bleeds into the right gutter at >= 1200px, the next slide peeking; a translucent strip at the slider foot holds the dark-blue appointment CTA, a derived "1 / 6" counter and prev/next arrows. Below 1200px the slider leads full-bleed (270/384px slides); below 768px the CTA sits under it
visualCharacteristics.differsFromBase: light=light, purpose page-intro match; image pattern differs (6-image slider vs single 4:3 image); structure adds brand-logo lists and two icon text links; density differs.
visualCharacteristics.layout: two-column >= 1200px (text 50%, slider 50% + gutter), stacked below (slider first)
visualCharacteristics.interaction: slider: prev/next buttons, swipe, counter; first slide eager/LCP
